variants.name: on を 1 行で・仕事の名前を変える

push:
name: ci
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
      - run: npm test
pr:
name: ci
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
      - run: npm test

push:
name: ci
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: 部品
        run: npm ci
      - name: 組み立て
        run: npm run build
      - run: npm test
pr:
name: ci
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: 部品
        run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
      - run: npm test

retry:
name: ci
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
